sanskrit: viṣkandhasya kābavasya kardamasyolūkyāḥ | apasthānasya kṛtyā yās teṣāṃ tvaṃ khṛgale jahi ||
english: The sorceries of viṣkandha, of kābava, of kardama, of the owl-demon (ulūkā), of apasthāna — those very sorceries, smite them at the gullet (khṛgala).

sanskrit: pra mṛṇīhy upahatyāṃ kardamaṃ nīlaśākyam | adhā sāram iva dāruṇa āyuṣ kṛṇomy antaram ||
english: Crush forth the traumatic affliction (upahatyā), the kardama, the blue-stemmed ailment (nīlaśākya); then, as one draws out the heartwood of a tree, I make an interval of life.

sanskrit: vividdhasyāvatṛṇṇasya hṛdasya cāhṛdasya ca | triparṇī viśvabheṣajī- -idaṃ kṛṇotu bheṣajam ||
english: For what is pierced, for what has been cut down, for the afflicted and for the unafflicted alike — let triparṇī, the universal healer, make this remedy effective.

sanskrit: kābavasya viṣkandhasya- -apasthāpanabheṣajam | idaṃ kṛṇomi bheṣajaṃ yathāyam agado 'sati ||
english: This is the healing remedy that expels kābava and viṣkandha, that restores proper placement (apasthāpana); I make this medicine so that this man here may be free of disease.

sanskrit: yasmād aṅgāt saṃsusrāva yad babhūva galantyaśaḥ | gāvo vatsam iva jānānās tat paraitu yathāyatham ||
english: From whichever limb the blood has streamed out, from what has become the dripping gore — let that return to its rightful place, even as cows recognise their calf.

sanskrit: nāsṛg asti pataṅgasya tardasya maśakādyāḥ | veṇoḥ pūtudror nāsty asṛṅ māsya glaur māpacid bhuvat ||
english: There is no blood in the locust (pataṅga), in the tarda (woodpecker), in gnats and their kind; there is no blood in the reed (veṇu), nor in the pūtudru tree — let there be no swelling (glau) in him, let there be no festering abscess.

sanskrit: ahaṃ veda yathāsitha gurvikā nāma vā asi | amuṃ tvaṃ tam ito gaccha yam ahaṃ dveṣmi pūruṣam ||
english: I know what you are and how you dwell — indeed you are named gurvikā (the blood-worm). Go you from here to that man yonder whom I hate.

sanskrit: tasyāpi madhya ā sīda nīlagrīvāsu sīdatā | vātasyānu pravāṃ maśakasyānu saṃvidam ||
english: Settle into his very midst; settle among the blue-throated ones (nīlagrīvā, Rudra's creatures). Follow the coursing of the wind, follow the compact of the mosquito.

sanskrit: preto yantv agruvo nir ito yantv agruvaḥ | adharācīm itaḥ paraḥ ||
english: Let the rootless ones (agruva) go forth from here; let the rootless ones go outward from here — downward, away from here, elsewhere.

sanskrit: prāhaṃ glāvam adhmāsaṃ nir ahaṃ glāvam adhmāsam | adharācīm itaḥ paraḥ ||
english: I have blown the swelling (glāva) forth; I have blown the swelling out from here — downward, away from here, elsewhere.

sanskrit: abhi tvām aham ojasā- -indro dasyūn ivābhuvam | sapatni naśyatād ito dūraṃ gacchādhy okasaḥ ||
english: I have overpowered you with might, as Indra overpowered the dasyus — O rival-wife (sapatnī), perish hence; go far away from this home.

sanskrit: sāsahā id ahaṃ patiṃ sāsahai śvaśurā ubhau | atho sapatnīṃ sāsahai yathā naśyāty okasaḥ ||
english: Verily I have overcome the husband; I shall overcome both fathers-in-law (śvaśura); moreover I shall overcome the rival-wife so that she perishes from this home.

sanskrit: abhibhūr aham āgamaṃ viśvakarmā mahāvadāt | ahaṃ mitrasya kalpayann eṣu gṛheṣu duṣṭarāt ||
english: As conqueror (abhibhū) I have come; as Viśvakarman from the great utterance; I who am arranging for the ally's (mitra's) sake in these houses, crossing what is hard to cross.

sanskrit: ut tiṣṭha mama vā idaṃ na tavehāpi kiṃ cana | māṃ caiva paśyann āyaty amuṃ ca divi sūryam ||
english: Arise — this here is mine; nothing whatsoever here belongs to you; he who comes will behold both me and yonder sun in the sky.
